Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 133. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Weapon Technique
Ki Cost: 14 Ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with
Casting Time: 1 Reaction to when a creature would
succeed a saving throw against a technique or spell
casted you
Range: Movement Speed
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: No
You take advantage of their focus in their success and
go up to a creature, making an attack to set you up for
the next one. Make a Melee Combo Attack Roll, on a hit
dealing your weapon’s damage die + 1d10. On a hit, you
deal your weapon’s damage and creature cannot react
to the next attack from you or an allied creature.
